rows.notes: Real CE edge builder/traverse and selector read the per-surface flag byte (walkable bit 6, breakable bit 7). Asserts the stock Prisoner walkable pattern from the raw payload (walkable 0,1,94,500; not 100,457,902,2838), that all 8 stock breakables are not walkable, that the selector still returns non-walkable probes (CE's selection ignores the walkable bit), and that clearing the synthetic gate's walkable bit reroutes the real smoothing (smoothing.gate_blocked, breakable.smoothing_avoids_destroyed). Finding: stock breakables are unreachable in the walkable graph.
